basic_details.post_name: Project Assistant (Admin.) / Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) / Sr. Project Scientist

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate degree in any field, M.Sc./ Postgraduate in Applied Geography with First class
qualification.details: Project Assistant (Admin.): Graduate degree in any field with at least 02 years of experience. Preference for experience in establishment and admin matters, MS office tools, maintenance of accounts, processing of bills, purchase procedures. Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.): Graduate degree in any field with at least 10 years of experience. Preference for experience in establishment and admin matters, MS office tools, maintenance of accounts, GeM and non-GeM purchase procedures. Sr. Project Scientist: M.Sc./Postgraduate in Applied Geography with First class and minimum 3 years experience in Forest Ecosystem Analysis, Dynamic Vegetation Modelling, Vegetation Phenology, Forest Carbon Dynamics, Climate change impact. Strong knowledge of remote sensing and GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS, ENVI, SNAP, ERDAS Imagine), AI/ML techniques, satellite datasets (Landsat, Sentinel, MODIS). At least five publications in reputed journals.

salary_details.details: Project Assistant (Admin.): Rs. 39,420 - 51,420/- p.m. plus HRA @27% Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.): Rs. 47,790 - 62,350/- p.m. plus HRA @27% Sr. Project Scientist: Rs. 60,750 - 79,260/- p.m. plus HRA @27%

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi recruitment is 16th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the positions of Project Assistant (Admin.), Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.), and Sr. Project Scientist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions at IIT Delhi involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for these positions by sending their applications via email to the designated address as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (Admin.) post?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant (Admin.) post offers a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 39,420 to Rs. 51,420, plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for the Sr. Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: For the Sr. Project Scientist role, candidates need an M.Sc./Postgraduate in Applied Geography with First class and at least 3 years of relevant experience in specific areas like Forest Ecosystem Analysis and remote sensing.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation provided by IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The positions advertised by IIT Delhi for Project Assistant (Admin.), Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.), and Sr. Project Scientist are on a contractual basis.
